proposed_rules.trigger: A sibling pair [bg:color] immediately followed by [bg:image], both with no captured text, standing alone as a visual break between text sections on a solution page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a single 'screenshot visual' image block placed in its own section (the color shape is a decorative backdrop CSS effect, not a section-wide background it wraps other content in).
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs verbatim across solution pages (this cluster's rc1c2c3, also C70 rc1c2c4) as a product-screenshot mockup with a color blob behind it. Rejected alternatives: (a) fold into background-container-is-section-style since the image is likely meaningful product content, not decoration to discard; (b) drop as decorative-graphics-are-noise for the same reason — the image itself carries content value even though its color backdrop does not.

proposed_rules.trigger: The last content zone before the global footer is captured as an empty container with no text or tagged children.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction rather than assuming the page ends abruptly; likely related-links or a secondary CTA that fell below the minWidth capture.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same failure mode as underrendered-list-zone but manifests as a blank trailing block rather than a list grid.
